maddeler.e:
استتفهن (form X)
# اِسْتَتْفَهْنَ (istatfahna) /is.tat.fah.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَتْفَهَ (istatfaha)
# اُسْتُتْفِهْنَ (ustutfihna) /us.tut.fih.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَتْفَهَ (istatfaha)
# اِسْتَتْفِهْنَ (istatfihna) /is.tat.fih.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَتْفَهَ (istatfaha)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
